items.heading: Cepelinai
details: Key ingredients: grated potato, ground meat, sour cream, bacon
Mix grated raw and cooked potato into a sticky dough.
Wrap a ball of dough around a seasoned ground meat filling, shaping into an oval.
Boil gently until the dumplings float and are cooked through.
Serve topped with fried bacon bits and sour cream.

items.heading: Saltibarsciai
details: Key ingredients: beetroot, kefir, cucumber, dill, boiled egg
Grate cooked beetroot and mix with kefir or buttermilk.
Stir in diced cucumber and fresh dill.
Chill the bright pink soup thoroughly.
Serve cold with a boiled egg and warm potatoes on the side.
